html:
SMTO-MEM-0013 — Knowledge can't open the selected conversation

GUID: dd2e5533-84a5-51ca-9ccf-effaa6e6fe64
Slug: knowledge-conversation-unavailable
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • Knowledge tried to use a conversation that no longer exists or was deleted, so it couldn't show or add sources for that conversation.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Knowledge, select Refresh, then pick the conversation again from the Choose a conversation list. The list may still show a conversation that was deleted after the page loaded.
  2. Open Chat and check that the conversation still appears in your conversation list. If the conversation was deleted, its Knowledge sources can't be opened or added to any more.
  3. If it's gone, choose another conversation, or create a collection under Private collections, upload the files there and use Attach selected collection. A collection keeps your files ready to attach to any conversation, including new ones.

What success looks like

  • The conversation's sources load in the document list on the Documents tab.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the conversation's name, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete other conversations or Knowledge sources while you look into this.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • RagService.require_conversation rejected the conversation ID because it is empty, does not exist in the conversations store, or the conversation has been deleted (tombstoned); the request returns 404.

What this means

  • The selected conversation cannot currently be opened in this account. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported conversation_unavailable. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The selected conversation opens and its sources load.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Confirm the conversation ID exists and is not tombstoned in the conversations and native_runs records for this account. Indexing jobs for a deleted conversation stop here by design; select a live conversation, or store reusable sources in a collection and attach it.
  • Return to Chat and select an existing conversation you can access, then reopen Knowledge.

Retry and execution caution

  • The selected conversation opens and its sources load.

How to verify the fix

  • The selected conversation opens and its sources load.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
